notes.title: v0.2.0 Released
notes.content:
Last few days i was reading your Bug Reports and feedback and here is my Response with some Fixes and some new Content.


New Map: Meadow

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514520/5d0ef257934e47576e32652072d67744df7259bb.png

This Map is brand new and not perfectly optimized yet. you might have to set the Graphics down a bit now but i'm working on Optimazation to make it playable much more smooth



New Settings Menu

i had many Reports about the Settingsmenu and many Bugs while Changing something. Now we have a completely new Menu with much more customa options including Post Processing to customize the overall look of the Game. Just play with the settings a bit. The Raytracing Option is also supporting older Graphicscards that use Hardware RTX without extra CUDA Cores.

Controller Support for Ally and Steamdeck

We also Improved the Controller Support and now the Forest Scene is Completely playable with Xbox Controllers and Gaming handhelds like Ally and Steamdeck. also the Settings UI is fully usable with controllers. 

The MainMenu and the Meadow Map are not fully supported yet and we're still working on that.


Other Changes

• Improved Mouse Movement
• Extra Setting for Controller Sensitivity
• Reduced Cloud Quality a bit to improve performance
• Local Storage to save Changed Settings 
• Any Changes in the Settings now should load when starting the Game
• Little Unity Upgrade
• Upgraded some Shaders 
• GPU Instancing enabled for all Shaders



We're Working on

• Performance increase for new Meadow Map
• New ingame content
• Fixing the Timescale and enable Steamachievements again
• Bug Fixes


Thats all for now.
Dont forget to touch some Grass between your Gaming Sessions.

Best,
Backii

*EDIT

Fixed a small Issue where max  sensitivity was 1. now its 10 and 1 by default

notes.title: v0.1.6 Hotfix
notes.content:
Thanks for Reporting Bugs and give Feedback.

Here are a few Bug fixes and changes:


• Fixed Volume Slider in the MainMenu
• Fixed Volume Name
• Added Mouse Sensitivity to Ingame Options
• Added Raytracing to Ingame Options (instead of always enabled)
• Fixed Fullscreen switch
• Fixed endless Loading Screen.
• Fixed House going Weee after walking in the Wall
• Fixed Player wasnt able to Jump
• Fixed Sun and Weather Shaders for GeForce 900 Series
• Improved Performance on Low End CPU's
• Fixed Ingame Sound


Mouse Sensitivity might fix the Camera issue that many of you have. We're still looking for another Solution. 

Thats all for now.

See ya soon with new content,
Backii


*EDIT*
for those of you who have issues loading into the game.
in the next update we'll set Game default settings to Medium and Raytracing disabled. this will fix the endless loading in issue.

notes.title: Early Access Release
notes.content:
Early Access Launch!

its finally done. We're launching in Early Access. We're made a couple Changes and Improvements.


• New Menu UI
• New Graphics Settings
• Wet Shaders on Windows and Ground while its Raining
• Performace Improvement
• 2 New Maps (Available in other Version Soon)
• Removed Phone Feature since we ran into some issues (it will be available later in Go Outside Together)
• Graphics Improvements
• Raytracing only available in Ultra Settings now
• Fixed Resolution Change
• Controller Support (Currently only for the Character!)
• Water Shader improvement


While we're waiting for your feedback and Bug Reports, we're still working on some stuff:


• Full Controller Support
• Full Play Support for Steam Deck, ASUS ROG Ally, MSI Claw, etc...
• Bug Fixes
• more advanced Rain Shaders.
• Make the House more Beautiful from outside.
• Water Interaction
• New Maps
• New Content



You always can Suggest new ideas using the Feedback Button Ingame.

See ya soon,
Backii
